mapper.select: SELECT EMPNO, ENAME, JOB, MGR, HIREDATE, SAL, COMM, DEPTNO, PHOTO_URL FROM EMP ORDER BY EMPNO

SELECT E.EMPNO, E.ENAME, E.JOB, E.MGR, E.HIREDATE, E.SAL, E.COMM, E.DEPTNO, E.PHOTO_URL, D.DNAME, M.ENAME AS MGR_ENAME FROM EMP E LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO LEFT JOIN EMP M ON E.MGR = M.EMPNO WHERE E.EMPNO = #{empno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMP (EMPNO, ENAME, JOB, MGR, HIREDATE, SAL, COMM, DEPTNO) VALUES (#{empno}, #{ename,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{job,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mgr,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{hiredate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{comm,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{deptno,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.update: UPDATE EMP SET ENAME = #{ename,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JOB = #{job,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MGR = #{mgr,jdbcType=INTEGER}, HIREDATE = #{hiredate,jdbcType=DATE}, SAL = #{sal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, COMM = #{comm,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, DEPTNO = #{deptno,jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE EMPNO = #{empno}
mapper.select: SELECT EMPNO, ENAME, JOB, MGR, HIREDATE, SAL, COMM, DEPTNO, PHOTO_URL FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = #{deptno} ORDER BY EMPNO
SELECT EMPNO, ENAME, JOB, MGR, HIREDATE, SAL, COMM, DEPTNO, PHOTO_URL FROM EMP WHERE TO_CHAR(HIREDATE, 'MMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MMDD') AND TO_CHAR(HIREDATE, 'YYYY') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
